data.title: Staking Ethereum, Solana or Avalanche (AVAX): Which Pays You More in 2026?
data.description: Staking crypto looks simple until you factor in the new coins each network mints, the lock-up periods that trap your funds, and tax rules that hit you even when prices fall. The coin advertising the biggest yield may actually leave you with the least.
